name: market_risk_offhours_20261031
comment: ANCHOR: MARKET_RISK_OFFHOURS_20261031 — Market Risk Engine off-hours: session labels incl. the 24/5 overnight
session, market-hours decay clock (weekends/holidays do not age Friday's close; Sunday 18:00 reopen), reader
session tag + post-close reference re-based on the day's own close, extended_hours names the last quote and its
age, regular-close feeds are not after-hours prints, --shadow writes the snapshot with no alert path. Hermetic.
Round 3 (review of #2415 round 2): 32 market-hour limits for daily-bar categories (Fri bars on Wed
read UNKNOWN; backtest with a 3-session data gap), shadow marker in the CIO line, fail-closed extended prints
(no reference_date / no source), no CALM unless every proxy is proven fresh, seasonal on the New York date.
Round 4 (review of PR 2425): hold-not-escalate on data carried across a closure (operator-approved),
shadow never overwrites the live snapshot and never carries a live episode, options-flow staleness from
the snapshot slots (one missed or late slot tolerated).
Round 5 (review of PR 2425 round 4): carried decided by the session a row belongs to (holiday-stamped
rows are carried; MLK and Labor Day cases), torn live snapshot -> not_evaluated keeping the live episode,
decay.bootstrap_mode, bootstrap never pages P1, torn prior never a bootstrap, options slots == lane registry.
Round 6 (review of PR 2431): CARRIED-ONLY mark (no episode, no repeats, no P1/P2 while a tier rests only on
carried data; released by fresh agreement), deleted prior with traces is not a bootstrap, receipts dated by
content with replays ignored, 60-second fresh window pinned.
Round 7 (review of PR 2431 round 6): a never-alerted (CARRIED-ONLY) tier is not held by hysteresis and the
mark clears only when fresh data reaches the tier; an open episode in the ledger is never a first run.
